errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps all five energy types to their corresponding colors. According to the legend, the correct mappings are: Електроенергия (bottom-most blue segment), Природен газ (red segment), Течни горива (green segment), Твърди горива (purple segment), and Енергия за отопление (top-most teal segment).

errors.text_span: DK има най-висок дял на енергията за домакинствата от около 21%
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that Denmark (DK) has the highest share of energy for households. According to the chart, the orange diamond for Slovakia (SK) is visibly higher (approx. 22-23%) than the one for Denmark (approx. 21%).

errors.text_span: Няма явно подреждане на стълбите по стойност
errors.evidence: The description claims there is no ordering of the bars by value. However, the bars are clearly sorted in ascending order of their total height (total energy cost).
